I can see the issue! The cart-service pods have been deployed with new labels from the Helm chart template. The Service is looking for the selector `app: cart-service`, but the new pods have labels:
- `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`
- `app.kubernetes.io/instance: cart-service`
- `app.kubernetes.io/version: 4.2.0`

This is a label mismatch - the Service selector won't match any pods. Let me check the logs to confirm there's no other issue:
